title: Connect/disconnect during connection with blukon
symptom: During connection with Blucon, the device disconnects and reconnects repeatedly, and sometimes commands fail with a NACK error. The logcat shows connection state changes and a missing write_characteristic_cb callback.
cause: The issue was likely due to a missing write_characteristic_cb callback, which was fixed in a commit.
fix: Update to the latest version since commit 05c51872b19c643eb5146e5c5d86844d03d4baf4.
evidence_quote: Good catch noticing the write_characteristic_cb missing, try the latest version since this commit: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/05c51872b19c643eb5146e5c5d86844d03d4baf4
